item.title: Cephx Key Migration Procedure and Ceph 19.2 Squid Going EOL Soon
item.author: invalid@example.com (t.lamprecht)
item.dc:creator: t.lamprecht
item.content:encoded:
Recent security findings and fixes in Ceph make it necessary to upgrade ceph and migrate authentication keys from the aes to the aes256k cipher. This is to address weaknesses in the old Cephx authentication method, especially if your Ceph service networks are not isolated. Upgrading to Ceph Tentacle 20.2.4 or newer, or Ceph Squid 19.2.6 or newer, will trigger new Cephx health errors and warnings for the old aes type. item.dc:creator: wolframio
item.content:encoded:
I would like to suggest adding **I/O Delay (%)** as a first-class resource usage indicator in the Proxmox VE Web UI.

Currently, Proxmox provides useful real-time information for resources such as CPU usage, memory usage, disk activity, network traffic, and other metrics.
